title: Valve now allows the “vast majority” of AI-powered games on Steam
author: tomeks

comments.author: tomeks
comments.body: Anyone here submit a game on steam lately to confirm if this is true? if it is let's get to work my friends and get our games our there everyone!

replies.author: XxXBengalTigerXxX
replies.body: Yeah I have, just need to fill out a bit of a form stating whether its pre generated AI Assets, or if the images are generated on the fly, and I think just a brief explanation of which assets are AI

replies.author: constroyr
replies.body: Is it an issue if they're generated on the fly or is it just for their information?

replies.author: XxXBengalTigerXxX
replies.body: No idea, I imagine the image generation parameters might be a factor in that scenario. Like if it were liable to make something illegal/pornographic they might not allow it. I just checked No for that box.

replies.author: sgallouet
replies.body: Even after filling the AI part in Jan once it got available, my game is still under review since then, with no comments.

replies.author: artoonu
replies.body: Yup, I can also confirm. I had a game from over half a year ago caught in block, decided to wait it out instead of getting new AppID. I just had to fill new AI disclosure box and resubmitted, was accepted after a while.

replies.author: questmachina
replies.body: I've got a live store page, but I haven't submitted a final bundle yet -- that's where I'm guessing the real testing of those form fields will come in. Curious if anyone has gotten push back at that step.

comments.author: lplegacy
comments.body: Good. Hopefully the AI hate fad dies out soon so we can focus on actual cool uses of this tech

comments.author: cleroth
comments.body: That's a 3 month old article btw

comments.author: DoctaRoboto
comments.body: Has anyone released an AI powered game under these new rules? I remember you Artoone, didn't you developed visual novels? Is there any limit regarding AI content? What about AI generated voices/music? Can somebody share links/names or any AI game aproved by Steam recently?
